limitations.description: Direct boundary normal flux evaluated from piecewise constant element gradients inside linear tetrahedral elements exhibits first-order O(h^1) discretization error against analytical boundary flux.
limitations.remedy: Mesh refinement decreases error monotonically from 53.26% (Nx=1) down to 3.96% (Nx=16/20). Variational nodal reactions provide work-conjugate equilibrium exact to 8.36 microwatts.

limitations.description: Benchmark is an uncorrupted mathematical software verification against analytical 1D ODE solutions.
limitations.remedy: Acceptance status is strictly bounded as PASS_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE; no physical or industrial qualification is claimed without hardware test data.
